positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · RunDeck · Ubuntu · Bootstrap · Jenkins · Docker Products · Node.js · Salesforce.com Development · HTML5 · Google Analytics · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Load Balancing · Bitbucket · Jira

positions.title: Senior Technical Consultant
positions.description: Worked on a project at Employment Development Department (EDD). The EDD UI Modification (UIMOD) project entails the redesign of Continued Claim Redesign (CCR). I as a technical designer along with the design team are responsible for the technical design. Our design encompasses functional area across the entire CCR process. As a result, we produce many work products (UML diagrams such as ERM, class diagrams, sequence diagrams, etc..) that are useful to the development team and deliverable technical documents for our client. We design the entire system from the database structure and organization to the software system, business services, business orchestrations, workflows, reports, web interfaces, etc.. We work with the business team to understand the functional aspects of the system and explain our design to the development team to build the system.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Bootstrap · HTML5 · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Angular
